pages.title: Three new districts — Polavaram, Markapuram, Madanapalle

pages.title: Madvi Hidma killed in Maredumilli encounter

facts.text: Who: Madvi Hidma — top CPI (Maoist) commander, head of the Central Military Commission (CMC)
facts.head: Encounter

facts.text: When: early hours (6–7 a.m.) of 18 November 2025
facts.head: Encounter

facts.text: Where: near Nellooru village, Maredumilli Mandal, Alluri Sitharama Raju (ASR) district, AP — near AP–Chhattisgarh–Telangana tri-junction (Karegutta hills area)
facts.head: Encounter

facts.text: By: Special Party team of ASR district police
facts.head: Encounter

facts.text: Also killed: wife Madkam Raje (Rajakka) and four other Maoists
facts.head: Encounter

facts.text: Born: Puvarti/Purvati village, Sukma (then undivided Madhya Pradesh, now Chhattisgarh); tribal
facts.head: Profile

facts.text: Rise: child cadre (Bal Sangham) early 1990s → commander, PLGA Battalion No. 1 → head of CMC
facts.head: Profile

facts.text: ⚠ Youngest and a rare tribal member of the Central Committee (only tribal CC member from Bastar)
facts.head: Profile

facts.text: ⚠ Reward: ₹50 lakh (not ₹10 lakh)
facts.head: Profile

facts.text: Attacks: ~26 major attacks
facts.head: Profile

facts.text: Year: 2010; Attack: Dantewada (Tadmetla) — ~76 CRPF killed
facts.head: Profile

facts.text: Year: 2013; Attack: Jhiram Ghati — Congress leaders killed
facts.head: Profile

facts.text: Year: 2017; Attack: Sukma / Burkapal — 26 CRPF killed
facts.head: Profile

facts.text: Year: 2020; Attack: Minpa–Burkapal ambushes
facts.head: Profile

facts.text: Year: 2021; Attack: Tekulgudem–Pedagelur — 22 security personnel killed
facts.head: Profile

facts.text: Operation Kagar (2025): Union-led multi-state anti-Maoist offensive — target to end Maoism by March 2026
facts.head: Context

facts.text: Basavaraju (Nambala Keshava Rao), former General Secretary, killed May 2025
facts.head: Context

facts.text: Central Committee shrank from ~42 (2004) to ≈12 (2025)
facts.head: Context

facts.text: PLGA: People's Liberation Guerrilla Army — armed wing of CPI (Maoist)
facts.head: Context

pages.title: India's first AI University in Amaravati — LG AI Research

facts.text: Meeting: CM N. Chandrababu Naidu met Yunjo Ko (Chief Sustainability Strategy Officer, LG Chem) at the 30th CII Partnership Summit, Visakhapatnam
facts.head: News

facts.text: Proposal: collaborate with LG AI Research (South Korea) to set up India's first AI University in Amaravati
facts.head: News

facts.text: Goal: India's first dedicated AI University and AI Innovation Cluster
facts.head: News

facts.text: Focus areas: Generative AI, AI for governance, language & multimodal AI, high-performance computing
facts.head: News

facts.text: Other partner: earlier MoU with NVIDIA (2025) for the AI ecosystem / compute infrastructure
facts.head: News

facts.text: Talks began: informally at World Economic Forum, Davos 2025
facts.head: News

facts.text: Objectives: integrate EXAONE-like large models; establish a Korea–India AI Knowledge Corridor
facts.head: News

facts.text: Next step: official AP team to visit LG AI Research, Seoul
facts.head: News

facts.text: Item: LG AI Research; Detail: Established December 2020; HQ Seoul; central AI think tank of LG Group
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Item: Mandate; Detail: AI research for 16 LG Group affiliates (incl. LG Chem, LG Electronics)
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Item: EXAONE; Detail: LG's LLM series — EXAONE 1.0 first (language & multimodal), EXAONE 4.0 latest
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Item: CII Partnership Summit 2025; Detail: Visakhapatnam, November 14–15
facts.head: Background

facts.text: ⚠ Partner is LG AI Research — not Samsung AI Research or Google DeepMind
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Issue: school restructuring/mergers disrupted rural schooling — some children missed up to six months of classes
facts.head: News

facts.text: Trigger: village protests over shifting Classes 3–5 to "Model Primary Schools"
facts.head: News

facts.text: UDISE data (2014–2024): government schools in AP fell 4%; private schools rose 7%
facts.head: News

facts.text: Example: Bangaramma Kandriga village — students asked to walk 2.5 km
facts.head: News

facts.text: Government: YSRCP (2019–24); Model: School Rationalisation Policy (2023) — primary schools kept only Classes 1–2; Classes 3–5 merged with nearby high schools
facts.head: Two rounds of restructuring

facts.text: Government: NDA–TDP (current); Model: Model Primary Schools (one per panchayat) for Classes 3–5; other schools downgraded to Classes 1–2
facts.head: Two rounds of restructuring

facts.text: Framework: both followed NEP 2020-aligned restructuring
facts.head: Two rounds of restructuring

facts.text: Model school gaps: only 1 usable classroom, 3 teachers instead of 5, 1 washroom shared
facts.head: Two rounds of restructuring

facts.text: Amma Vodi (YSRCP) / Thalliki Vandanam (TDP): ₹13,000/year per child to mothers — private schools collect it, driving migration
facts.head: Welfare link

facts.text: ⚠ RTE Act, 2009 neighbourhood norm: school within 1 km for Classes 1–5 — mergers forced 2–3 km walks
facts.head: Background

facts.text: UDISE+: Unified District Information System for Education
facts.head: Background
